That gave me raw PNGs, but they’re just crops of the whole page; I’m missing a clean, isolated capture of the #install section, and the cropped images might still include surrounding whitespace or scrollbars. 

The user likely wants crisp, element‑specific screenshots that match the site’s layout exactly, especially for the #demo, #features, and #install sections highlighted on the page. Playwright can directly target DOM elements via locators and produce screenshots of just those elements, which will be higher quality and avoid any extra background. I have already verified that Playwright is installed earlier (the subagent task listed it among the tools), but I should double‑check that the Python bindings are importable before launching the heavy script. A quick `python3 -c "import playwright; print('pw-ok')"` will confirm the package is present and avoid a cryptic failure later.

1. Imports the synchronous Playwright API.
2. Launches a Chromium browser (headless by default).
3. Opens a new page with a viewport matching the earlier screenshots (1440×900) to keep dimensions consistent.
4. Navigates to the local file URL `file:///home/lane/GR/site/index.html`.

6. Takes screenshots of the three sections identified by their IDs: `#demo`, `#features`, and `#install`, saving them to `/tmp/site-demo2.png`, `/tmp/site-features2.png`, and `/tmp/site-install2.png` respectively.
7. Closes the browser and prints a success marker (`SHOTS-OK`). If anything goes wrong, the except block will print an error with the exception message, which is useful for debugging.

I’ll combine the import check and the script into a single Bash command, separating them with a semicolon so I can see the import result first (`pw-ok`) and then run the full script. I’ll also redirect all output to stdout (`2>&1`) so any errors are captured. try:
    from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        b = p.chromium.launch()
        pg = b.new_page(viewport={'width':1440,'height':900})
        pg.goto('file:///home/lane/GR/site/index.html')
        pg.wait_for_timeout(5500)
        pg.locator('#demo').screenshot(path='/tmp/site-demo2.png')
        pg.locator('#features').screenshot(path='/tmp/site-features2.png')
        pg.locator('#install').screenshot(path='/tmp/site-install2.png')
        b.close()
    print('SHOTS-OK')
except Exception as e:
    print('ERR', e)
